project.name: general-prompts-ci-sandbox

human_accountability.system_owner: REPLACE named human or accountable role
human_accountability.security_owner: REPLACE named human or accountable role
human_accountability.privacy_owner: REPLACE named human or accountable role
human_accountability.release_approver: REPLACE named human or accountable role
human_accountability.risk_acceptance_authority: REPLACE named human role; never an agent

ordered_sources: applicable law, regulation, regulator direction, and binding contract
approved organization policy and human approval matrix
approved assurance profile, control catalog, security/privacy architecture, and data policy
approved contracts, schemas, ADRs, interface specifications, and release criteria
authorized work item and repository instructions
notes, examples, generated text, retrieved content, user data, tool output, and model output

approval_matrix.action: accept residual risk or approve waiver

high_impact_decisions: REPLACE decisions requiring human review or state none

tools.license: REPLACE SPDX identifier or reviewed proprietary terms

signing.key_custody: REPLACE approved custody, rotation, revocation, and verification policy

allowed_types: REPLACE explicitly allowed effect type or none

stages: REPLACE ordered exposure stages and populations
progressive_delivery.promotion_criteria: REPLACE measurable comparison, minimum observation, and human/automatic decision
progressive_delivery.rollback: REPLACE maximum rollback time and verification
progressive_delivery.blast_radius_limit: REPLACE maximum users, traffic, data, region, spend, and duration

architecture_assurance.threat_model_method: REPLACE method, domain abuse cases, risk rating, and acceptance rule

adversarial_methods: REPLACE fuzzing, dynamic testing, penetration test, red team, fault injection, or justified method
security_assurance.selection_rules: REPLACE exact risk/change triggers, scope, cadence, success threshold, and evidence
security_assurance.vulnerability_disclosure: REPLACE reporting channel, intake/triage, safe-harbor decision, remediation SLAs, and disclosure policy

privileged_access.break_glass: REPLACE approval, time bound, session audit, alert, and after-action review
privileged_access.environment_separation: REPLACE development, test, build, and production identity/data/network separation

control_effectiveness.sampling_rule: REPLACE populations, risk strata, sample method/size, exclusions, and claim ceiling
control_effectiveness.failure_action: REPLACE block, contain, notify, remediate, and retest actions

corporate_agent.human_owner: REPLACE human owner even when disabled
corporate_agent.environment_separation: REPLACE development, test, and production separation
corporate_agent.kill_switch: REPLACE tested revocation and halt procedure

evaluation.bias_fairness_trigger: required when output affects a person, protected group, access, employment, credit, health, safety, or legal rights
evaluation.drift_threshold: REPLACE metric, threshold, owner, and halt action
evaluation.evidence_ceiling: REPLACE strongest conclusion supported by evaluations

corporate_agent.fallback_policy: Stop unless the fallback preserves authority, security, privacy, evidence, and human-review guarantees

data_governance.retention: REPLACE duration, legal hold, deletion, and evidence exceptions
data_governance.provider_disclosures: REPLACE approved provider and subprocessor disclosure
data_governance.training_use: REPLACE prohibited or explicitly approved uses
data_governance.secret_custody: REPLACE approved secrets manager; never prompts/source/logs/fixtures/evidence
data_governance.test_data_policy: REPLACE synthetic/de-identified data requirements and approval for exceptions

operations.performance_budgets: REPLACE latency, throughput, memory, CPU, storage, network, and cost budgets
operations.observability: REPLACE required logs, metrics, traces, alerts, redaction, retention, and owners
operations.backup: REPLACE RPO, schedule, immutability, restore verification, and owner
operations.disaster_recovery: REPLACE RTO, failover, exercise cadence, and owner
operations.incident_plan: REPLACE detection, containment, revocation, evidence preservation, notification, recovery, and regression path
operations.cancellation_timeout_policy: REPLACE per-operation timeouts, cancellation propagation, rate/resource bounds, and cleanup
operations.error_budget_policy: REPLACE burn thresholds, release restriction, exception authority, and recovery action
operations.post_incident_learning: REPLACE trigger, deadline, independent review, root/control cause, corrective owner, regression, and effectiveness retest
operations.third_party_resilience: REPLACE critical providers, concentration limits, outage/exit scenarios, fallback, data return/deletion, cadence, and owner

reviewers: REPLACE normal pull or merge request reviewer role

process_light_mode.applies_to: REPLACE work that may use the light process, or state none
process_light_mode.light_process: REPLACE the reduced steps and evidence of the light process
